scripts.dev: npm run build:catalog && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.build:catalog: vite build && vite build --config vite.printer.config.mjs && vite build --config vite.share.config.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:catalog && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: node --test tests/printing.test.mjs tests/receipt-share.test.cjs && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:catalog && node scripts/prepare-android.mjs && cap sync android
